material_qualifications: Security updates and version updates remain separate capabilities.
UV fallback branch excludes the preceding security-support predicate; table and prose version literals remain source-qualified.
NuGet table <=6.12.0 and CLI prose most features through6.8.0 remain distinct.
OpenTofu community item uses literal Julia predicate, unlike dedicated OpenTofu section.
Prose update-type and YAML update-types literals not silently normalized.
Grouping precedence and version-tag examples preserved as inert source examples, not executed policies.
Native settings, registry credentials, costs, publication and linked-body review not inferred.
